prayerExcerpt.en-US: "While our lips say 'I believe', our mind and our heart must be able to say 'I see'."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Enquanto os nossos lábios dizem 'creio', a nossa mente e o nosso coração devem poder dizer 'vejo'."

meta.face: A Neapolitan priest of about forty, clean-shaven, with a warm olive complexion and a LONG, NARROW face tapering to a pointed chin — a high forehead, short dark hair parted at the side and brushed back, RECEDING a little at the temples, LARGE ears that stand out, dark, earnest eyes behind small ROUND wire-rimmed spectacles, level dark brows, a long, straight nose, hollowed cheeks, FULL lips closed; the gaze direct and gentle. Not the round, smiling josemaria_escriva, nor the grey-crested titus_brandsma of this batch. The boys: one round-faced with curly black hair, one thin with short straight brown hair.
meta.basis: His photographs as a young priest (the Dicastery's portrait; the painted portrait on the Vocationists' shrine, reproduced by Vatican News): a long, narrow face with a pointed chin, short dark hair, round wire spectacles, prominent ears, a long straight nose and full lips, in a cassock with a short cape. Photographs of his old age show a rounder face with a wide smile; the card keeps the younger face, of his founding years, so as not to repeat josemaria_escriva.
meta.excerpt: His conviction «La perfezione della Fede è la visione e quindi, mentre le nostre labbra dicono credo, la nostra mente e il nostro cuore devono poter dire vedo», as the Dicastery's biography quotes it; the second clause, a short quotation, our rendering (he died in 1955)
